newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's RTVE in digital TV talks with key groups.
newsitem.headline: Spain's RTVE in digital TV talks with key groups.

text.p: Radio Television Espanola (RTVE) will close deals in the next few days with important communications partners to launch eight digital television channels in 1997, according to a Spanish newspaper report.
Daily newspaper El Mundo listed Brazil's El Globo, Time Warner, and Rupert Murdoch as potential partners.
A spokesman for RTVE declined to comment, but said the group would publish a statement later today on this issue.
Late on Tuesday, Mexican communications group Televisa said that it was in advanced talks with RTVE to launch digital television to the market.
In its statement, Televisa also said the talks involved other potential partners in this project.
